record_type_quote: This study presents a three-year replication and extension of Maurer’s (2013) evaluation of a classroom activity to reduce prejudice and discrimination.

targets.title: Evaluation of a classroom exercise on social distance and discrimination.
targets.evidence_quote: The current study seeks to replicate and extend the findings of Maurer’s (2013) investigation.
targets.outcome_quote: Results differed significantly from those reported by Maurer (2013), and suggested that all three methods tested were equally effective in reducing prejudice and discrimination and that such changes were lasting.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The original's greater change after the BSDS activity versus lecture control was not recovered; equally effective methods contradict that central comparative finding. General positive change is not replication of the activity's superiority.

reasoning: New classroom sample explicitly re-tests Maurer (2013). The APA recommendation supplies the activity, not an empirical target; other prejudice literature is background.
